items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Guy Lombardo. [INTERVIEWEE] (laughter) ... [INTERVIEWER] And Louie has said that he and the other guys in the band used to run out on intermission, turn on the radio and listen to Guy Lombardo. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.
